content.text: Imagine being a digital creator in Nigeria or Venezuela, locked out of Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad due to platform restrictions. Your online store is crippled, unable to process payments or deliver products to customers. This is the harsh reality for many creators worldwide. In this guide, we'll explore how to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or other platform gatekeepers. Let's dive into the world of infrastructure sovereignty and discover how to create a self-sufficient online store.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages offer a powerful alternative to traditional e-commerce platforms. By leveraging these services, you can host your digital store on a custom domain, process payments through NOWPayments, and deliver products to customers without relying on Stripe or other platform gatekeepers. This infrastructure is not a workaround; it's a deliberate choice to own your digital presence and sovereign commerce stack.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Stack 02 — the Edge Commerce Stack — uses Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling, Supabase for order storage, Cloudflare R2 for product file delivery, and Resend for transactional email. The entire stack costs nothing per month up to significant volume thresholds — Cloudflare Workers provides 100,000 requests per day free, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage free, Cloudflare R2 provides 10GB storage and zero egress fees free, and Resend provides 3,000 emails per month free. SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are configured during COREMERCH deployment to ensure delivery emails reach inboxes rather than spam folders. The end-to-end test before handoff confirms that the complete pipeline — payment to webhook to order log to delivery email — functions correctly on mainnet before the creator is handed control.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments and Supabase with your Cloudflare Pages deployment. This involves integrating your payment gateway with your product catalog and setting up automated delivery mechanisms. With the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, this process is simplified and streamlined, allowing you to focus on creating and marketing your digital products.
Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages offer a powerful alternative to traditional e-commerce platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your digital store is a straightforward process. You'll need to test your infrastructure, configure your payment settings, and promote your store to potential customers. With the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you'll have access to a comprehensive deployment checklist and dedicated support to ensure a smooth launch. Once live, you'll be able to process transactions and deliver products to customers without relying on Stripe or other platform gatekeepers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your digital store is a matter of adapting your infrastructure to meet growing demand. With the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you'll have access to advanced scaling playbooks and expert support to ensure a seamless upgrade. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and other infrastructure services, you'll be able to scale your store quickly and efficiently, without relying on traditional e-commerce platforms.
